description:
WHAT: Fortress Shield (agent I/O PII protection). Catalog of every PII and secret entity type, which ones the free tools run on this Worker (pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text) vs only in the paid Actor (NER names/locations, and fetching remote PDF/document URLs; http(s) URLs in text are detected locally; STREET_ADDRESS patterns run locally with detectAddresses), redaction styles, sealed-map support, and the price of every paid tool in this server.
WHEN: Before pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text to pick entityTypes, or to explain coverage and costs to a user.
WHEN NOT: To actually scan text (pii_scan_text) or redact it (pii_redact_text).
COST: Free; no token.
RETURNS: One catalog object; local:true marks the detectors the free tools run (see PARAMETERS). features.sealed_map.available says whether this deployment can seal placeholder maps.
BEHAVIOR: Runs on this Fairquery-hosted Worker (Cloudflare), not on the caller's machine; inputs leave the client. This Worker's code is designed not to store inputs, results, or an Apify token. No further network call; the catalog is compiled into this Worker, instant (<10 ms). No rate limits.
PARAMETERS: None: call with an empty object {}; the catalog is always complete and cannot be filtered. Its output feeds other tools' parameters: copy detector "type" values verbatim into entityTypes of pii_scan_text / pii_redact_text (only rows with local:true can match there) or pii_guard_documents (all rows, incl. PERSON / LOCATION / STREET_ADDRESS); redaction_styles keys are the allowed redactionStyle values.
EXAMPLE: {} -> {"detectors":[{"type":"AWS_ACCESS_KEY","category":"secret","local":true},...]}
name: pii_list_detectors
title: Fortress Shield: list PII/secret detectors and pricing (free)
